turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Who entered the zero on Owen's essay, and why did he see it before I did?
That's your business, Hale. Today you answer for Owen's essay.
Meetings like this are why. Should I?
You're asking me to decide your career for you? Decide who entered that zero first.
Please, I really need someone outside the building to just tell me what they'd do.
I'm not outside anything, I'm Owen's mother. You called this meeting, so run it.
